title: Numerical Approximation and Discretization
description: Numerical techniques for mathematical processes involving discretization, including interpolation, splines, least squares fitting, numerical differentiation and integration, and introductory ODE methods.

title: Introduction to Relational Databases
description: Overview of database systems including ER modeling, relational design, normalization, SQL, and data warehouse concepts.

title: Introduction to Software Engineering
description: Design, construction, validation, and evolution of modern software systems with emphasis on real-world development practices and ethical considerations.

title: Computer Hardware and Operating Systems
description: Covers instruction sets, pipelining, caching, virtual memory, and operating system fundamentals.

title: Computer Graphics
description: Introduction to graphics including transformations, rendering, shading, lighting, and animation.

title: Introduction to Computer Networking
description: Basic networking concepts including protocols, routing, and distributed application design.

title: Software Engineering Project
description: Team-based design and implementation of a large software system.

title: Intermediate Algorithm Design and Analysis
description: Study of algorithms including graph algorithms, data structures, and computational complexity.

title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: Problem solving, planning, search algorithms, and applications of AI.

title: Applied Machine Learning
description: Practical machine learning including data cleaning, feature engineering, supervised and unsupervised learning.

title: Machine Learning and Data Mining
description: Advanced ML including clustering, regression, dimensionality reduction, and probabilistic models.

title: Human Computer Interaction Methods
description: Introduction to user interface design, task analysis, and evaluation methods in HCI.

title: Advanced Relational Databases
description: Advanced database topics including indexing, query optimization, transaction processing, concurrency control, and recovery systems.

title: Computational Optimization
description: Algorithms for optimization including linear, nonlinear, network, and integer optimization with duality and sensitivity analysis.

title: Advanced Software Engineering
description: Development of large-scale software systems including multi-version systems, design patterns, and validation techniques.

title: Introduction to Compiler Construction
description: Design and implementation of compilers including lexical analysis, parsing, type checking, and code generation.

title: Distributed Systems
description: Principles of distributed computing including communication, fault tolerance, naming, and distributed file systems.

title: Parallel Computation
description: Parallel algorithms and architectures including shared memory, message passing, and performance analysis.

title: Advanced Algorithms Design and Analysis
description: Advanced algorithm design including graph algorithms, approximation algorithms, and complexity theory.

title: Intelligent Systems
description: Design of intelligent systems including natural language processing, expert systems, and symbolic AI.

title: Computer Vision
description: Image processing and computer vision including recognition, stereo vision, motion analysis, and 3D reconstruction.

title: Computer Animation
description: Animation techniques including keyframing, motion capture, physics-based animation, and character simulation.

title: Video Game Programming
description: Game development including rendering, AI, animation, and real-time interactive systems.

title: Advanced Machine Learning
description: Deep learning, probabilistic models, graphical models, and advanced inference techniques.

title: Advanced Methods for Human Computer Interaction
description: Advanced HCI methods including user modeling, experimental design, and field studies.

title: Algorithms in Bioinformatics
description: Computational biology algorithms including sequence alignment, phylogenetics, and gene analysis.

title: Introduction to Visualization
description: Design and implementation of data visualization systems for analytical reasoning and communication.
